title: data/runs.json: which model, at which effort, made each run (v0 draft)
$comment: Evidence and votes name a run; this says who ran it. The operator, not the model, supplies these values.

model.description: The model id, for example claude-sonnet-5-5.

effort.description: The effort level it ran at. xhigh is called extra high in the apps.

agent.description: external: a model run by someone else, whose model and effort are self-reported and not verified.

note.description: Where the model and effort were read from.
